summary: El Grande is a tense area-majority game where lords place knights across Spanish regions to seize control at three scoring checkpoints. Much of the tension comes from bidding on power cards for turn order and secretly committing knights to the castillo before big reveals.
praised: tense simultaneous bidding for turn order
criticised: can feel mean and swingy when majorities flip late
King placement by the last player can feel arbitrary

interaction.kind: area majority with direct removal effects
interaction.detail: Caballeros from every player are placed onto the same regional map and scored by majority, so every placement competes for control of the same spaces. Some power/action cards let a player directly remove or displace opponents' caballeros from a region, going beyond simple space denial into a direct hit on their board presence.

scoring.how_you_win: Across scorings after rounds 3, 6 and 9, hold the most (or 2nd/3rd most) caballeros in each region to bank points; the highest cumulative total after round 9 wins.
